outcome: Need for high-flow nasal cannula O(2) supplementation
Discharge to long-term acute care facilities
Discharge with a home O(2) requirement
cohort: Pregnant women and reproductive-aged, non-pregnant women admitted for severe or critical coronavirus disease 2019
finding: Pregnant women with severe and critical coronavirus disease 2019 are at an increased risk for certain morbidities when compared with non-pregnant controls.
mod_finding: Among the pregnant women who underwent delivery, 72.7% occurred through cesarean delivery and the mean gestational age at delivery was 33.8±5.5 weeks in patients with severe disease status and 35±3.5 weeks in patients with critical coronavirus disease 2019 status.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at delivery was 33.8±5.5 weeks in patients with severe disease status and 35±3.5 weeks in patients with critical coronavirus disease 2019 status
